parsed.title: AI toolkits, bus anecdotes, diploma cover costs, weather, and mini‑PC GPU hack

claims.text: AI models themselves are not inherently intelligent; complex abilities come from toolkits and ready‑made solutions.
Testing AI with modern toolkits like opencode in 2022‑2023 may be limited by small context windows of older models.
InstinctGPT comparison shows that toolkits can boost performance but cannot fully compensate for lacking base model abilities.
Older models were trained on large data without understanding, whereas modern models try to extract maximal ability from fewer parameters and may be fine‑tuned for specific tasks.
The author observes odd behavior from a person on a bus, including playing piano loudly and later making micro‑sounds that disturb his mother.
The same person allegedly emitted gas on a second encounter.
The author notes generally strange people on public transport.

topics.title: Fitting multiple GPUs in a small PC case

claims.text: In a small PC case that officially fits only one small GPU, the author managed to fit three GPUs using straps and force.
